title: IS12:: f2c_table.c (4.5)

lines.explanation: The upper and lower limit of the table and the incremental step are declared as variables. These variables are initialized below.

lines.code: lower = 0;   /* lower limit of temperature table */

lines.explanation: The running variable fahr is initialized to the lower limit of the table
The loop will if the current value of fahr is less or equal the upper limit (here 300).
This is the main calculation in body of the loop - we calculate current temperature in Celsius scale corresponding to the current value of temperature in Fahrenheit scale
Both temperature values are being printed in a fixed format
step is added to the current value of fahr. This prepares us to the next iteration of the loop.
This bracket ends the block that constitutes the body of the loop
